Episode 12
Keshav wants to find out if his wife has really become blind or she is merely acting. When Keshav is at Prema’s house trying to heal Prema’s leg injury, Koki arrives and reveals that her eyes are perfectly fine. Later, Koki’s mother is paying her a visit. Next door, it’s Prema’s father who is arriving shortly. What will happen when Koki’s mother and Prema’s father meet? Watch this episode to find out.
